title: PMA S6b — deterministic consensus. NO MODEL PRODUCES THIS FILE.
description: Verdict is arithmetic over the seats' Round 2/3 positions; every prose field is a verbatim quote attributed to a named seat. Nothing here is generated. Supersedes the retired pma_committee_read schema (v0.1), whose per-name frame_consistency and challenge_response fields are carried forward below as AGGREGATIONS of seat output rather than as a desk agent's synthesis. NOTE: unrelated to plan.schema.json's held_actions[].committee_read enum (D-34), which is a different, live, legacy field.

rule_version.description: Version of the published consensus rule applied, so any verdict can be re-derived from the same positions later.

deliberation_set_rule.description: The narrowing rule that produced this set (RB:committee.deliberation_threshold), recorded so the input population is reproducible.

conviction_cap_applied.description: Which cap bound the conviction, if any. Caps only ever lower; nothing raises conviction above what the seats themselves gave.

contested.description: An exchange closed without the raiser's conviction moving. A legitimate terminal state — printed, never resolved by the orchestrator.

decisive_exchange.description: COMPUTED, not judged: the exchange that moved the most convictions between rounds.

bear_case.description: Strongest OPPOSE argument, or strongest self-authored counter from a high-conviction supporter. VERBATIM. Mandatory on ADVANCE.

dissent.description: Named minority positions, preserved never averaged. (v0.1 carried a single string; an array is required to keep multiple dissenters distinct.)

frame_fit.description: PORTED FROM v0.1 committee_read.frame_consistency. Per-name regime fit. A contradiction does NOT kill an idea — Crown is weather, not a gate — but it must be argued by a named seat, and the argument is that seat's own words.

argument.description: VERBATIM quote from that seat. Never generated.

challenge_responses.description: PORTED FROM v0.1 committee_read.challenge_response, but as attributed per-entry records rather than one summary string. Aggregated verbatim from round2_position.answers_challenge — the substance of how each rogers entry was met, alongside the completeness certificate's record of WHETHER it was met.

falsifiers.description: Union of every seat's what_would_make_me_wrong for this name.

conditions.description: HOLD-FOR-CONDITIONS only: the observable that would promote it.

portfolio_view.description: Arithmetic only. Flags, never blocks — position-level risk gates live outside PMA.

concentration.description: Sector/factor counts across the ADVANCE set

stopped_by_rule.description: Which clause of the consensus rule stopped it

blind_spots.description: Union of NOT_SERVED fields that mattered + ingest degraded flags + empty seats
